fusions.name: Seal the Growth
fusions.desc: A stroke that deals 10 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Leaden] for 8 seconds, its Speed drained. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Polyp Bloom
fusions.desc: Stings every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 3 poison damage and leaves them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Breakwater by Inches
fusions.desc: Grows a reef 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 9 seconds, and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
